div.div: 6 ترامزوا [They made signs, or indications, in one or other of the manners described above, one to another]. You say, دَخَلْتُ عَلَيْهِمْ فَتَغَامَزُوا وَتَرَامَزُوا [I went in to them, and they made signs and indications, &c., one to another]. (A, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
